shared_elements: low-relief curvilinear motifs carved on stone
circular disc / ring with central boss (A: large round eye; B: ring motifs)
paired symmetrical arcs or crescent forms
justification: Both surfaces carry rounded, bulging low-relief curvilinear forms, and both include a prominent circle/ring with a raised centre plus paired symmetrical arcs, which is the most specific overlap. However, A depicts a single recognisable crouching creature in profile filling the field horizontally, whereas B shows a vertical stack of purely abstract rings, crescents and a belt-like band with no discernible animal or figure, so relationships and arrangement do not correspond.
